name: Arugula, Mushroom & Quinoa Salad with Lemon-Chive Vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
708 ml (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Wash and mince chives.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together the garlic, ½ of the chives, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
juice of 1 ½ lemon
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Dijon mustard
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry arugula. Transfer to a large bowl. Add the remaining minced chives.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add pine nuts and, stirring constantly, cook until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup pine nuts

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet to stove and add more oil. Add mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until just tender, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Uncover quinoa and fluff with a fork. Add quinoa, mushrooms, and pine nuts to bowl with arugula. Toss to combine.
To serve, place salad on a plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
